title: Figma: Design in the Browser
description: A fast breakdown of Figma: Design in the Browser for builders.

hook.text: Design tools were desktop applications that couldn't share work in real time.

buildup.text: Figma put the entire design tool in a browser tab. Anyone with a link could view and edit.

discovery.text: Real-time collaboration meant designers and developers worked on the same file simultaneously.

twist.text: Adobe tried to buy Figma for $20 billion but regulators blocked the deal.

climax.text: Figma proved that even professional creative tools could move entirely to the web.

punchline.text: A browser tab replaced a desktop application.

quiz.question: What makes Figma different from traditional design tools?
options: It runs entirely in the browser
It uses AI to design automatically
